_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistics (3% of windows with ±2pt moves over 7 days) and the analyst's 0-for-18 record on forced directional calls in coils make HOLD the only statistically honest call until either ETF flows turn positive or VIX/DXY confirm a breakdown.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil conditions and divergent factors; narrative implies a bullish mean-reversion setup without a formal HOLD, creating a split between 'wait for confirmation' and 'bottom is forming'
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive (>30) with funding dropping below 35 and stablecoin growth turning positive — validates a Disbelief recovery leg with actual capital commitment
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 25 with DXY strengthening past 102 and BTC funding flipping negative — pushes to Panic breakdown, confirming the August-bottom divergence was actually top-forming distribution
